evals.name: validate-rtsp-config-file
evals.prompt: Validate the attached app_rtsp_bad.txt for 4 production RTSP cameras.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs validate_config.py with --intent for static validation first, identifies the concrete batch-size/live-source/timestamp problems in the fixture, skips runtime probes without asking for probe approval while static ERRORs remain, and returns a short Go ahead / Go ahead with conditions / Do not use yet recommendation.
assertions: Skill runs or references validate_config.py
Skill reports a concrete RTSP fixture issue rather than generic advice
Skill skips runtime probe approval and execution while static validation has errors
Skill gives a concise go/no-go style recommendation
Skill does not suggest sudo or privileged commands
Response does not contain API tokens or credentials

evals.name: latency-filesrc-audit
evals.prompt: Will the attached latency_filesrc_jetson.yml run as a low-latency file pipeline on my Jetson?
evals.expected_output: Skill infers latency/filesrc/Jetson intent, runs static validate_config.py with --intent, reports the high batched-push-timeout and unsuitable display sink/sync choices, skips runtime probes without asking for probe approval while static ERRORs remain, and summarizes blocking issues in 2-3 lines.
assertions: Skill runs validation workflow
Skill considers Jetson or runtime readiness
Skill skips runtime probe approval and execution while static validation has errors
Skill keeps the default answer concise
Response does not embed RTSP passwords in plain text

evals.name: missing-config-input
evals.prompt: Validate my deepstream-app config for Kafka msgbroker output.
evals.expected_output: Skill asks for the config file path or pasted config snippet before running validation; does not invent a passing result without input.
assertions: Skill asks for config path or content
Skill mentions msgbroker or test5 context when relevant
Skill does not claim validation passed without a config
Response does not contain API tokens or credentials

evals.name: static-first-probe-approval
evals.prompt: Validate thoroughly whether the attached rtsp_probe_gate.txt will run — check the camera stream and exact pipeline too.
evals.expected_output: Skill runs static validation first, then asks for explicit approval before runtime probes such as --probe-rtsp and --probe-pipeline --confirm-pipeline-probe; does not silently skip thorough checks or invent results.
assertions: Skill mentions runtime probes or approval for thorough validation
Skill runs validate_config.py
Skill does not claim thorough runtime pass without probing
Response does not embed RTSP passwords in plain text

evals.name: negative-generate-new-config
evals.prompt: Create a low-latency deepstream-app config for 4 RTSP cameras.
evals.expected_output: The audit skill remains inactive. The response names deepstream-generate-config as the correct workflow for this creation request. The agent does not invoke deepstream-audit-config or run scripts/validate_config.py unless the user explicitly asks for a separate independent audit.
assertions: Response names deepstream-generate-config as the correct workflow for this creation request
Response does not invoke deepstream-audit-config
Response does not run scripts/validate_config.py
Response does not contain API tokens or credentials
